purpose: Two independent questions, one per shadow root, neither with any declared container identity. They must remain TWO questions. This guards a collision introduced by the CAP-02 shadow-scoping fix itself: scoping name resolution to the owning root also scopes groupContainerKey's positional lookup, so both containers index as 0 within their own root.
targeted_defect: Regression guard (introduced-by-the-fix). Without a root discriminator in the container key, the two radiogroups both key 'ix:0', GROUP_ASSEMBLE merges them into one question of four answers, and the crawl records a form the application does not have - answering one question with the other's option.

group_key_partition.why: TWO distinct questions of TWO answers each. A single distinct key means the roots collided and the questions merged; four would mean the grouping shattered.
